"""Molecule calculator: the properties of every molecule you put in.

Add molecules in the Molecules tab (paste SMILES, one per line with an optional name; drop .smi, .csv or .sdf
files; or add them from the Library). Change run() to compute anything else RDKit knows.
"""

import render as r
from data import molecules
from rdkit.Chem import Crippen, Descriptors, Lipinski, rdMolDescriptors


def run():
    mols = molecules()
    if not mols:
        return [r.text(("No molecules yet: add some in the Molecules tab.", "還沒有分子：請在「分子」分頁中加入。"))]
    rows, names, weight, logp = [], [], [], []
    for name, mol in mols:
        mw, lp = Descriptors.MolWt(mol), Crippen.MolLogP(mol)
        hbd, hba = Lipinski.NumHDonors(mol), Lipinski.NumHAcceptors(mol)
        broken = sum([mw > 500, lp > 5, hbd > 5, hba > 10])
        rows.append(
            [
                name,
                rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol),
                f"{mw:.1f}",
                f"{lp:.2f}",
                hbd,
                hba,
                f"{rdMolDescriptors.CalcTPSA(mol):.1f}",
                rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumRotatableBonds(mol),
                "yes" if broken <= 1 else "no",
            ]
        )
        names.append(name)
        weight.append(mw)
        logp.append(lp)
    return [
        r.metric(("Molecules", "分子數"), len(mols)),
        r.metric(("Pass the rule of five", "通過五規則"), sum(row[-1] == "yes" for row in rows)),
        r.table(
            ["Name", "Formula", "MW", "logP", "HBD", "HBA", "TPSA (Å²)", "Rotatable bonds", "Rule of five"],
            rows,
            ("Properties (computed by RDKit)", "性質（由 RDKit 計算）"),
        ),
        r.scatter(
            weight,
            logp,
            names,
            (
                "Molecular weight against logP; shaded: MW ≤ 500 and logP ≤ 5",
                "分子量對 logP；陰影：MW ≤ 500 且 logP ≤ 5",
            ),
            ("Molecular weight (g/mol)", "分子量（g/mol）"),
            ("logP", "logP"),
            box=(500, 5),
        ),
        r.grid(
            [m for _, m in mols[:12]],
            [n for n, _ in mols[:12]],
            ("The molecules (first 12)", "分子（前 12 個）"),
            per_row=4,
        ),
    ]

title: Similarity matrix
相似度矩陣
templates.code:
"""Similarity matrix: how alike every pair of your molecules is (Morgan fingerprints, Tanimoto similarity).

Add molecules in the Molecules tab. 1.00 on the diagonal; above about 0.4 two molecules usually share a scaffold.
"""

import render as r
from data import molecules
from rdkit import DataStructs
from rdkit.Chem import rdFingerprintGenerator


def run():
    mols = molecules()
    if len(mols) < 2:
        return [r.text(("Add at least two molecules in the Molecules tab.", "請在「分子」分頁中加入至少兩個分子。"))]
    gen = rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganGenerator(radius=2, fpSize=2048)
    fps = [gen.GetFingerprint(m) for _, m in mols]
    names = [n for n, _ in mols]
    sim = [DataStructs.BulkTanimotoSimilarity(f, fps) for f in fps]
    nearest = []
    for i, row in enumerate(sim):
        j = max((k for k in range(len(row)) if k != i), key=lambda k: row[k])
        nearest.append([names[i], names[j], f"{row[j]:.2f}"])
    return [
        r.metric(("Molecules", "分子數"), len(mols)),
        r.table(
            ["", *names],
            [[names[i], *[f"{v:.2f}" for v in row]] for i, row in enumerate(sim)],
            ("Tanimoto similarity", "Tanimoto 相似度"),
        ),
        r.table(
            ["Molecule", "Nearest", "Similarity"],
            nearest,
            ("Each molecule's nearest neighbour", "每個分子最相似的另一個"),
        ),
    ]

"""@EN@: PDB @ID@ (https://www.rcsb.org/structure/@ID@)"""

import render as r
from data import fetch_pdb  # downloads from RCSB the first time, then keeps a copy on your computer

PDB = fetch_pdb("@ID@")


def run():
    atoms = [ln for ln in PDB.splitlines() if ln.startswith(("ATOM  ", "HETATM"))]
    chains = sorted({ln[21] for ln in atoms})
    residues = {(ln[21], ln[22:27]) for ln in atoms if ln.startswith("ATOM  ")}
    ligands = sorted({ln[17:20].strip() for ln in atoms if ln.startswith("HETATM")} - {"HOH"})
    return [
        r.metric(("Atoms", "原子"), len(atoms)),
        r.metric(("Chains", "鏈"), ", ".join(chains)),
        r.metric(("Residues", "殘基"), len(residues)),
        r.metric(("Other molecules", "其他分子"), ", ".join(ligands) or "–"),
        r.pdb3d([{"pdb": PDB, "colour": "#0f766e"}], ("@EN@", "@ZH@")),
    ]

"""@EN@: AlphaFold DB model of UniProt @ID@ (https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/entry/@ID@)"""

import render as r
from data import fetch_alphafold  # downloads from AlphaFold DB the first time, then keeps a copy

MODEL = fetch_alphafold("@ID@")


def run():
    plddt = [float(ln[60:66]) for ln in MODEL.splitlines() if ln.startswith("ATOM  ") and ln[12:16].strip() == "CA"]
    colour = ["#0053d6" if v > 90 else "#65cbf3" if v > 70 else "#ffdb13" if v > 50 else "#ff7d45" for v in plddt]
    return [
        r.metric(("Mean pLDDT", "平均 pLDDT"), f"{sum(plddt) / len(plddt):.1f}"),
        r.metric(("Residues below 50 (likely disordered)", "低於 50 的殘基（可能無序）"), sum(v <= 50 for v in plddt)),
        r.pdb3d([{"pdb": MODEL, "colour": "plddt"}], ("@EN@, coloured by pLDDT", "@ZH@，依 pLDDT 上色")),
        r.bars([str(i + 1) for i in range(len(plddt))], plddt, ("pLDDT of each residue", "每個殘基的 pLDDT"), colours=colour, vertical=True),
    ]
